[Trait] COSMIC ENTITY Galactus can't be the target of an attack with more than one target.
[Trait] GALACTUS HAS LANDED ON EARTH! POWER: Place Galactus anywhere on the map except an opponent's starting area or on special terrain. He can be placed on blocking terrain and immediately destroys that terrain when doing so.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
Unnamed Ability When playing Galactus, the Elemental converter dial is in use whether he is on your force or your Sideline.
ACCELERATING DESTRUCTION At the end of your turn, click the Elemental Convert dial once. If Galactus or the Herald KO'd an opposing character this turn, you may click it an additional time. (It can't be turned past click #20.) If [ta:power_cosmic] is revealed, heal Galactus equal to the number displayed on the dial.
CONVERTING PLANETS TO PURE ENERGY At the end of each opponent's turn, deal 1 unavoidable damage to each character on that force within X squares of a map edge where X is the number displayed on this dial.

property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
HOW TO PLAY THE HERALD DIAL You may pay 25 points to include the Herald dial on your starting force. This dial is in use whether Galactus is on the map or on your Sideline and this dial's effects apply until the Herald is KO'd. The 25 points for this dial are scored when the Herald is KO'd.
COSMIC REBIRTH During force construction, choose a standard friendly character whose point value is equal to or less than half the build total to become the "Herald". The Herald has a range value of 5 if it's printed range value is less and can't be equipped or replaced. The Herald has [ta:power_cosmic] and can use the power displayed on the Herald dial.
GALACTUS IS COMING! At the end of your turn, if the Herald is within 5 squares of an opposing character or KO'd an opposing character this turn, click the Herald dial once (turn it twice if both apply). The Herald dial can't be clicked past click #12.
YOUR WORDS ARE SPOKE! THE DIE IS CAST! SO SHALL IT BE! The Herald has "POWER: If you occupy an opponent's starting area, roll a d6. If the result is equal or more than the number displayed on the Herald dial, place Galactus anywhere on the map on his purple (100 point) starting line." (Galactus scores 100 points if KO'd.)
